sloka: युद्ध्यस्व वा धृतिं कृत्वा शौर्यमालम्ब्य राक्षस ।मच्छरैस्त्वं रणे शान्तस्ततः पूतो भविष्यसि ।। ६.४१.६९ ।।।।
transliteration: yuddhyasva vā dhṛtiṁ kṛtvā śauryamālambya rākṣasa ।maccharaistvaṁ raṇe śāntastataḥ pūto bhaviṣyasi ।। 6.41.69 ।।।।

translations.english: "This Vibheeshana, the best of Rakshasas will be glorious and fortunate undoubtedly having got the kingdom of Lanka."
